summary: Larry Baker, 80, of Fort Collins, reported missing after his vehicle was found at Watson Lake State Wildlife Area; full-scale search with LCSAR, dive team, dogs, drones and sonar

notes: Body located at Watson Lake on 2025-06-22 and identified 2025-06-23 as Larry Baker; Larimer County Coroner ruled the death an accidental drowning.
